exposure: preterm neonates undergoing surgery before 48 weeks post-conceptional age
cohort: 141 neonates (term newborn up to 4 weeks of age and preterm newborns up to 40 + 4 weeks of post-conceptional age) diagnosed with inguinal hernia
finding: The risk of incarceration is low in neonates discharged with known diagnosis of inguinal hernia.
